purpose: Teach: 後援/図表/台数/ターミナル/コーディネーター/歴代/三井/近況

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 地域マラソン、後援、続けるべきかしら、来期。
lines.en: Should we keep sponsoring the local marathon next term, do you think?
lines.style: Efficient, upward inflection on the question. Matter-of-fact. Delegates without fussing. Moves on to the next item.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。年次報告の図表、見やすく整理します。
lines.en: Yes. I'll organize the annual report charts so they're easy to read.
lines.style: Straightforward, ready-to-go tone. Brief nod of assent. Professional but warm — not robotic. Clean transitions between tasks.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 駐車場、車の台数、増やせるか、確認して。
lines.en: Can you check whether we can increase the parking lot capacity?
lines.style: Direct and delegating. Casual but clear. Not demanding, just matter-of-fact about what needs doing.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。空港ターミナルの広告、出稿、検討中です。
lines.en: Yes. We're currently reviewing options for an airport terminal ad placement.
lines.style: Status-report delivery. Steady, informative. No apology in the voice — just factual update. Maintains eye contact.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 広告のコーディネーター、来週、面接しましょう。
lines.en: Let's interview the ad coordinator candidate next week.
lines.style: Decisive and brisk. Light weight on the key verb. No room for negotiation, but not unkind. Assumes agreement.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。歴代社員の表彰式、感動的でしたね、昨日。
lines.en: Yes. The awards ceremony for past employees yesterday was really moving.
lines.style: Softer shift — genuine reflection. Small pause before the observation. Quieter than the task-mode. Invites her to share the moment.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 三井不動産との打ち合わせ、来週、火曜よ。
lines.en: The meeting with Mitsui Realty is next Tuesday.
lines.style: Calendar notation delivered as fact. No inflection needed — just timeline confirmation. Brisk but not abrupt.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社内、各部署の近況、まとめております。
lines.en: Yes. I'm compiling updates from each department across the company.
lines.style: Steady, in-progress tone. Slight emphasis on "compiling" — shows active work. Patient, thorough. Background task being handled.
